description: Extends Leaflet's MarkerClusterGroup and L.Marker classes with methods to refresh cluster icons and parent cluster icons, primarily for updating marker icons and cluster visuals dynamically.

classes.name: L.MarkerClusterGroup
classes.description: A class extended with methods to refresh cluster icons and parent cluster icons.

classes.name: L.Marker
classes.description: A class extended with a method to update icon options and refresh the marker.

methods.name: refreshClusters
methods.description: Updates icons of clusters and markers, optionally in singleMarkerMode.

methods.name: _flagParentsIconsNeedUpdate
methods.description: Flags parent clusters of given markers as needing icon update.

methods.name: _refreshSingleMarkerModeMarkers
methods.description: Re-draws icons for markers in singleMarkerMode.

methods.name: refreshIconOptions
methods.description: Updates marker icon options and optionally refreshes parent clusters.
